purpose: Re-audit the entire WB-only local pilot from its authoritative requirements through source, UI, runtime, installer and evidence; repair confirmed defects without inventing a new product milestone.
source_precedence: Explicit user instructions in the current task and latest correction
validated milestone RTMs and defect registers

milestones.title: Source-of-truth and repository reconstruction
requirements: Enumerate the complete tracked project delta and active runtime surfaces
Resolve contradictory plans, stale states and superseded milestone claims
Preserve WB_ONLY, READ_ONLY, Ozon deferred, Gatekeeper disconnected and marketplace writes disabled
Prove the audit branch descends exactly from the immutable base
milestones.pass_criteria: One unambiguous current source of truth and complete auditable scope inventory

milestones.title: Finance model and user-input contract
requirements: No hard-coded or silently prefilled cost, tax or other-expense business values
Tax rate is user-editable
Tax base/model is user-selectable
Other expense per unit is user-editable
Cost per product or group is user-editable
Return, compensation, advertising, discount and subsidy inputs are user-editable where used
Required missing values block calculation
Invalid, negative, non-finite or malformed values fail closed
Profile confirmation and persistence are explicit
Changing a saved profile changes subsequent calculations without code changes
Decimal arithmetic and rounding are deterministic
Return-cost rules do not double count compensated units
tests: editable-field source and UI contract tests
profile round-trip and corrupt-profile recovery tests
property tests for decimal inputs and boundaries
milestones.pass_criteria: All financial values originate from explicit user input or imported evidence and no required value is invented

milestones.title: Interface and usability Red Team
requirements: Financial profile is reachable from the main decision screen
Every editable value has a visible label and validation feedback
Calculate action cannot bypass incomplete profile validation
User can edit, save, reopen and change values
Keyboard navigation and Enter/Escape behavior are safe
Dialogs remain usable at common Windows scaling and smaller screens
Long product/group lists are scrollable
Errors are actionable and do not expose tracebacks as the only feedback
Queue controls and report actions expose correct enabled/disabled state
Cyrillic paths and values render and persist correctly
Closing dialogs cannot partially save invalid data
Single-instance and repeated-click behavior do not create duplicate operations
milestones.pass_criteria: Hosted Windows UI path is executable and no confirmed source-level usability blocker remains; physical visual acceptance remains L5

milestones.title: Input admission, storage and persistence
requirements: Only admitted XLSX content reaches calculations
Malformed, oversized, compressed-bomb, traversal and unsafe workbook inputs fail closed
Duplicate files are idempotent
Source copies and derived outputs are atomic and recoverable
Corrupt configuration does not silently reset to invented values
Concurrent queue and scheduler operations cannot corrupt state
Paths with spaces, Unicode and long names are handled
No raw commercial data is sent to external models or services
tests: archive and XML limit mutation tests
milestones.pass_criteria: All input and persistence paths are deterministic, local and fail closed

milestones.title: Calculation, outputs and recommendations
requirements: Observed WB metrics map to the correct calculation fields
Unassigned expenses remain visible and are not silently allocated
Excel, HTML and JSON totals reconcile
Weekly and monthly periods use complete deterministic boundaries
Scheduled and manual runs are idempotent
Output packages are SHA-256 bound and atomically published
Recommendations distinguish evidence, assumptions and forecast
Missing evidence lowers confidence or blocks claims
No unsupported profit or growth promise is emitted
milestones.pass_criteria: All outputs reconcile to one calculation result and claims do not exceed evidence

milestones.title: Installer, security and offline boundaries
requirements: Installer is built from the exact audited head
Native self-test passes after installation
Repair/reinstall preserves config, data and output
Uninstall and rollback behavior are documented
Installed launchers resolve the managed runtime correctly
Microsoft Defender is not required to be disabled
No marketplace write capability is enabled
No Ozon or Gatekeeper activation is introduced
Unsigned Quantum EXE is disclosed and not represented as signed
milestones.pass_criteria: One exact-head Windows candidate passes all applicable hosted installation gates

milestones.title: Adversarial plateau cycle
requirements: Search for stale constants, unreachable code, duplicated implementations and contradictory states
Inject malformed values and interrupted operations
Review exception swallowing, race windows and unsafe fallback behavior
Repeat Red Team until no new P0/P1 and no reproducible P2 correctness defect is found
Record every rejected candidate and exact reason
tests: two consecutive exact-head validation runs where practical
milestones.pass_criteria: Technical plateau: zero open P0/P1, zero known reproducible calculation/data-loss defects, and all applicable gates pass

milestones.title: Final exact-head evidence and integration decision
requirements: Validate the final exact head on Linux and hosted Windows
Bind installer and evidence artifacts to the final exact head
Update live state without predeclaring dynamic PASS
Keep main merge and production release unauthorized
Fast-forward the working branch only after validation PR closes unmerged
milestones.pass_criteria: Final audit head is validated and safely integrated into the working branch without main merge

milestones.title: Physical L5 operator pilot
requirements: Install on the operator computer
Verify real display scaling, Defender behavior and shortcuts
Enter user-selected finance values through the interface
Run real WB reports and manually reconcile sampled results
Verify persistence after restart and scheduled reports
milestones.pass_criteria: Physical pilot PASS on the actual operator computer

severity_policy.P0: data loss, unsafe external write, incorrect financial result without warning, security boundary breach or inability to start
severity_policy.P1: major required workflow unavailable, persistent incorrect output, installer/repair failure or critical UI blocker
severity_policy.P2: recoverable correctness, resilience or usability defect
severity_policy.P3: non-blocking maintainability, wording or cosmetic issue

claim_boundary.fully_ready_without_errors: NOT_CLAIMABLE_ABSOLUTELY; claim is limited to tested scope and known-defect register
